title: BRIGANDINE ABYSS
summary: BRIGANDINE ABYSS is NIS America's strategy RPG, released on Switch 2 on August 27, 2026, at $49.99. The install is small at 6.7 GB, but the physical edition is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge only unlocks the download. It targets 30 FPS, and not a locked one: docked play slows down when the camera and cursor move quickly, while handheld mode holds up better. The developer chose not to target 60 FPS on Switch 2. In a turn-based strategy game this matters less than in an action game, but if it bothers you, handheld is the smoother way to play. Note that Spanish is not among its six languages.
